jobs.title: Channels Operations Manager, Managed Services
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Rubrik’s Global Partner Organization is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to serve as a trusted business partner to our managed services ecosystem. In this role, you will own the operational strategy, program design, and go-to-market execution for Rubrik’s managed services business—driving alignment across managed service providers (MSPs), field sales, marketing, and product teams.

This is not a transactional operations role. You will act as a strategic advisor to MSP partners and internal stakeholders alike, shaping how Rubrik engages with and grows its MSP channel. You bring a proven track record of influencing without authority, building lasting partner relationships, and translating business strategy into executable programs. Your efforts will directly influence Rubrik’s market positioning and revenue growth in managed services.

**\*\*\* This position requires a minimum of 2 days/week at Rubrik's HQ in Palo Alto, CA \*\*\***

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Strategic Partnership:** Build deep relationships with MSP leadership to drive mutual growth and platform commitment.
* **Business Planning:** Create annual and semi-annual business plans with sales, setting shared goals and performance milestones
* **Performance Management:** Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to assess progress, address risks, and align on future priorities.
* **Programs:** Partner with the programs and incentives team to evolve the MSP program framework, including partner tiers, onboarding requirements, incentive structures, and growth criteria that reward and accelerate top performers.
* **GTM Strategy:** Develop and evangelize a GTM Strategy and Plan for the managed services route to market, galvanizing cross-functional action and ensuring consistent execution across field, marketing, and partner teams.
* **Data & Metrics:** Define and track metrics for individual MSP performance and program health, creating leading-indicator frameworks that enable proactive intervention and growth planning.
* **Pipeline and Forecast:** Drive pipeline accountability and forecast accuracy across the MSP channel, partnering with sales leadership to ensure visibility and predictability in MSP-sourced revenue.
* **Process and tools:** Lead highly cross-functional initiatives to identify and close gaps in managed services processes and systems, working across sales, product, finance, and partner success.
* **Internal Advocacy:** Serve as the internal champion for MSP partner needs, translating partner feedback into actionable insights for product, marketing, and enablement teams.

**Experience You’ll Need:**

**To be successful in this role, candidates should meet the following requirements:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year university.
* 5–7 years in a strategy and operations, channel operations, or partner success function within a technology or SaaS environment.
* Track record of serving as a strategic advisor or business partner to external partners or customers, driving joint business planning and outcomes.
* Proven ability to own and drive large cross-functional GTM initiatives in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
* Robust analytical background with familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau, or equivalent tools for pipeline and performance reporting.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Ability to develop trust-based with cross-functional internal stakeholders, driving alignment and results without direct authority.
* Experience managing channel ecosystems at scale, with a strong understanding of the MSP business model and go-to-market motion.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to develop a GTM playbook in line with organizational objectives, then operationalize it across teams.
* Strong analytical instincts—able to deconstruct complex problems, leverage data to drive decisions, and translate insights into partner-facing and executive-ready recommendations.
* Aptitude to identify growth opportunities within the managed services route to market and build programs that capture them.
* Solid experience with Salesforce and Tableau; comfort working with pipeline data and partner performance metrics.
* Excellent communication and executive presence—comfortable presenting to senior leaders, facilitating partner executive sessions, and driving cross-functional alignment.

jobs.description:
## **About the Team & Role:**

We're building Rubrik Agent Cloud, the enterprise platform to monitor, govern, and remediate AI agents. Our team operates at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and enterprise security, creating solutions that make it possible for organizations to operate production-grade AI agents at scale.

As a member of the Rubrik Agent Cloud team, you'll work with cutting-edge AI technologies while solving complex challenges in scaling, security, and performance. We're a collaborative team passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with enterprise AI infrastructure.

## **What You'll Do:**

As a  Cloud Platform Engineer on this team, you will be a key leader in building, governing, and optimizing the multi-cloud foundation that powers our platform. You will drive the strategy for how we securely and efficiently scale our services across various cloud providers.

This role is perfect for a hands-on technical leader who is passionate about automation, security, and mentoring a growing team.

**Design and Govern Secure Cloud Foundations:**

* Drive end-to-end cloud onboarding process for new business units, applications, and teams across multiple clouds such as **AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI**.
* Drive Implementation of **secure landing zones, multi-account/tenant structures, IAM and Policies**.
* Enforce **tagging standards**, **resource hierarchy models**, and **governance frameworks** to enable accountability, cost tracking, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and evolve **IAM, SSO, Org/Subscription/Project policies, and Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC)** across all clouds.

**Embed Security and Compliance at Scale:**

* Design and implement security controls including **encryption, KMS, VPC Service Controls, privileged access management (PIM),** and **audit logging**.
* Proactively address **security vulnerabilities**, **misconfigurations,** and **compliance** gaps in collaboration with the InfoSec teams.
* Lead periodic **Compliance** Audits, **cloud security** and producing **mitigation and remediation** strategies.

**Drive Automation, Efficiency, and Optimization:**

* Collaborate with the team for development of **Infrastructure-as-Code** (IaC) templates and **automation pipelines** using **Terraform**, **Cloudformation**, and **CI/CD (Flux, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD etc)** to support and manage various aspects of Cloud Operations.
* Continuously identify **cost-optimization** opportunities via **rightsizing, storage tiering, idle resource elimination,** and **architecture reviews.**

## 

## Experience You’ll Need:

You are a passionate and experienced cloud expert who thrives on building scalable, secure, and automated systems.

* **BS/MS** in **Computer Science** or a related field, or **equivalent practical experience**.
* **2+ years** of **CloudOps, Engineering, or Software Architecture experience**, with deep expertise in at least one major public cloud (**AWS**/**GCP/AZure**) and familiarity with others (**OCI, etc**).
* Expertise in **multi-cloud IAM**, **Org/Project design, security policies, logging/monitoring, and access controls**.
* Strong skills in automation and **Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)** using tools like **Terraform/CDK/Azure Bicep.**
* Proven experience in **cloud financial management** and **cost optimization** strategies.
* Excellent **communication, collaboration, mentorship, and leadership** skills.

## Nice to have:

* Knowledge of **regulatory compliance** frameworks (**SOX, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA**).
* Understanding of **FedRAMP** operational controls; past FedRAMP environment experience is a significant plus.
* Experience working at the intersection of infrastructure and product - a track record of working with product and backend engineers to design and build novel solutions that are not constrained by runtime environment e.g. onprem, customer cloud, neo cloud, or managed cloud
* Experience proactively solving customer pain points at the infrastructure level (simplifying customer onboarding procedures, redesigning systems to meet customer security requirements)
* Experience with modern performance programming languages such as Go, Rust is a plus
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure across clouds via **service mesh** networking (**Istio/LinkerD, envoy, eBPF** a plus).
* Experience building systems meant to be deployed in various external environments, such as **customer cloud accounts** (On-prem a plus).

jobs.description:
The Global Corporate Accounting team manages and drives the close which is a critical process for ensuring accurate and timely financial statements for cross functional teams including the SEC reporting and finance teams. Our partners primarily include FP&A, Revenue Ops, Financial Reporting, Tax, Treasury, IT, Sales Ops, Engineering, and Global Workplace Services. We operate a global team and work in lockstep with our offshore Corporate Accounting shared services team to enhance and scale processes. The Corporate Accounting team is responsible for accounting, adoption of new standards, and operationalizing the following areas including, but not limited to, payroll and related benefits, commissions, leases, and capitalized software, in accordance with US GAAP. 

We are looking for a seasoned and experienced **Corporate Accounting Leader** to lead our Corporate Accounting team. This leader will shape the future state accounting function roadmap, automation strategy, and how AI reshapes the close as the company scales. In this role, you will bring knowledge of best practices and proven experience scaling accounting processes to drive the team. You will mentor the team and leverage AI to drive efficiencies to the close process while staying in compliance with regulatory requirements such as SOX. You will work cross-functionally across the organization solving complex problems and driving a culture of transparency and accountability. Your influencing skills will extend your impact deep into the broader finance org and beyond. This role reports to the Senior Director, Assistant Controller at our HQ in Palo Alto and is an in-office hybrid role 3 days a week.

**What you’ll do:**

* Continually Enhanced and Scale the Close Process: Develop and execute a plan on how to scale the global accounting close process while incorporating changes in the business. Demonstrated use of AI/automation in accounting processes.
* Develop and Defend Accounting Positions:  Prepare and/or review accounting memos with ambiguous facts and situations and arrive at the appropriate conclusion.
* Mentor and Develop: Lead and mentor a team of corporate accounting professionals, as well as an offshore shared services team and relevant stakeholders.
* Positive Impact to Cross-Functional Organizations: Work closely with stakeholders to drive positive change for Rubrik.
* External Audit and SOX/Internal Controls Readiness: Ensure work product is compliant with US GAAP/PCAOB and SOX. Ensure high quality and timely deliverables to external/internal auditors.

**We're looking for someone who has:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA or equivalent certification is required.
* 12+ years of relevant experience, ideally with a mix of Big 4 public accounting and high-growth public software/technology company; have worked in Corporate Accounting and other functions within a CAO.
* Possess deep understanding of US GAAP; experience with reducing close timeline within sacrificing accuracy; worked in an environment that complies with SOX controls and Big 4 external audits requirements.
* Extensive experience with accounting tools (e.g., Netsuite, Xactly, LeaseQuery, Coupa) and Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with AI tools.
* Have a vision on what an efficient Corporate Accounting function should look like at scale in a high growth environment and drive change.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Strong communication skills and proven track record on being able to manage up and downwards.
* 3 days a week in the Palo Alto office.

jobs.description:
## **About The Team:**

Come join our growing Corporate IT team to architect and scale the technology foundation that powers Dynamic Work for our employees. As a Corporate IT Architect, you will focus on designing and evolving a secure, automated, and scalable internal IT ecosystem that delivers world-class technology experiences across our workforce and workspaces.

This role centers on building resilient systems and operational maturity across Service Desk, Endpoint Engineering, Collaboration Platforms, and AV environments. You will drive proactive architectural improvements, eliminate inefficiencies, and implement automation-first strategies — all while maintaining a strong commitment to security, governance, and employee experience.

As part of a globally distributed IT organization, you will partner closely with Security, Engineering, HR, and Finance to design standards, integrations, and lifecycle management frameworks that enable scale. This position is strategic yet hands-on — ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex systems problems, using data to guide decisions, and building sustainable solutions rather than reacting to tickets.

Our goal is to ensure employees have a seamless, secure, and highly productive technology experience — by design, not by accident.

**What you’ll do:**

* Define and maintain the target-state architecture for Corporate IT systems.
* Architect and mature Service Desk processes (incident, request, problem, change) with automation and self-service at the core.
* Implement AI Service Desk using LLMs and Virtual Agents for intelligent ticket routing, automated triage, and instant user resolution.
* Engineer end-to-end automation frameworks that transform manual support interventions into "self-healing" workflows
* Design modern endpoint management strategy across macOS and Windows using Jamf and Intune
* Establish patching, compliance, and configuration baselines with measurable enforcement.
* Own architecture and governance for Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and conference room AV systems.
* Work with partner teams to automate onboarding/offboarding workflows across integrated systems.
* Partner with Security to implement zero-trust principles and maintain audit readiness.
* Drive API-first integrations across platforms to reduce manual intervention.
* Rationalize tooling, manage vendor strategy, and optimize spend.
* Lead escalations and provide architectural oversight for complex cross-platform issues.
* Document standards, integration patterns, and lifecycle management strategies

## **Experience you’ll need**:

* 10+ years in Corporate IT, Endpoint Engineering, or IT Architecture roles within distributed or high-growth environments.
* Deep expertise in Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune.
* Strong administrative and architectural experience with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and SaaS ecosystems.
* Experience designing zero-touch device lifecycle management programs.
* Strong knowledge of identity and access management (Okta, Azure AD, or equivalent).
* Experience implementing ITIL-aligned service management processes.
* Demonstrated ability to design automation using scripting (Bash, Python, PowerShell) and APIs.
* Proven experience in tooling rationalization, vendor evaluation, and cost governance.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capability.
* Ability to operate independently while influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

## **Additional skills or certifications a plus :**

* Okta
* Google Workspace Administration
* JAMF Pro Certification
* Microsoft Intune Certification
* Atlassian Suite (JIRA Service Management)
* Slack Enterprise Administration
* Zoom Rooms / AV architecture

### **Customer Resilience Manager (CRM)**

**Location: Cork, Ireland**

The Customer Resilience Manager (CRM) is a critical position within the Customer Success organisation, responsible for managing the post-sales journey of select Enterprise Accounts at Rubrik. The CRM serves as the primary point of contact, advocating for the customer, maximising their return on investment (ROI), and coordinating efforts to achieve their business goals and objectives. This role functions as an extension of the Sales Account Team, collaborating with customers to facilitate faster adoption, demonstrate time to value, and enhance overall customer engagement and satisfaction.

CRMs are responsible for driving product enhancements and managing escalations, leveraging cross-functional relationships to maintain and strengthen customer confidence in Rubrik's leadership in Cyber Resilience. The position's overarching objective is to deliver an industry-leading customer experience for Rubrik customers through both proactive and reactive measures. Success in this role requires exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, which are vital for mediating and driving the achievement of customer tactical and strategic business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Acquire comprehensive knowledge of account background, key stakeholders, goals, requirements, and expectations of Rubrik.
* Ensure prompt responses and communications to achieve and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Collaboratively develop and execute success plans to meet customer goals and objectives.
* Assume ownership of the customer's journey and touchpoints with Rubrik, including training on support engagement, idea submission, self-service options, and navigation of the support portal.
* Monitor customer environments, identify proactive measures to prevent issues, and ensure accounts remain in good standing. Provide customers with insights, performance benchmarking, and recommendations.
* Collaborate with internal organizations such as Sales, Marketing, Operations, Engineering, QA, and IT to improve overall customer satisfaction.
* Manage account and case escalations, including setting customer and account team expectations regarding support, and forming virtual cross-functional teams as necessary to achieve customer satisfaction. Coordinate, draft, and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documents for customer issues.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, lessons learned, and other processes to prevent escalations.
* The CRM role encompasses the entire customer lifecycle, including onboarding, the initial 90-day experience, and strategies to ensure Rubrik footprint adoption and growth.

**Education & Experience Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related discipline is preferred.
* A minimum of 8 years of experience in a customer experience and/or account management role within a technology-based company is required.

**General Skills:**

* **Competence, Knowledge, and Confidence:** Ability to coordinate and lead necessary resources to fulfil customer needs and expectations.
* **Customer-Centricity:** Demonstrates a strong customer orientation, characterised by proactive and positive engagement.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Capable of assembling and leading team initiatives and resources.
* **Communication Proficiency:** Possesses excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
* **Proven Experience:** Demonstrated expertise in escalation management, proactive management, and account management at the global IT Enterprise level.
* **Professional Attributes:** Self-driven, proactive, hardworking, and a team-player with a positive disposition.
* **Interpersonal Acumen:** Exhibits excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, with a proven ability to partner with and develop working relationships at all levels, and with multiple internal and external teams and customers.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to effectively communicate with executive/senior management, cross-functional teams, internal customers, external partners, vendors, and end-users.
* **Travel Flexibility:** Willingness to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion.
* **Availability:** Preparedness to work outside standard business hours when circumstances necessitate.

jobs.title: Director, Corporate IT — Employee Experience & AI
jobs.description:
# About Rubrik

Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We’ve been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup.

Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

# **Job Introduction**

Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket.

We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee’s access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is “My Digital Twin”, an agentic layer carrying an employee’s full context alongside the organization’s memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs.

This is a multi-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip.

The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global.

# The environment

A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS and open source applications.

* Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc.
* Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc.
* VDI and remote desktop environments
* AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production
* ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management)
* Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc.
* Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms
* and others

# What you will be doing

## Run the business: operational excellence today

* Own the global end-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones.
* Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all-hands production.
* Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees.
* Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you.
* Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow-the-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites.
* Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area.
* Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits.
* Represent operations in cross-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy & Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps.

## Change the business: build toward ticketless

* Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site.

* Build the organizational memory that “My Digital Twin” depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action.
* Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection.
* Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails.
* Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design.

* Depth in identity and access (Okta or equivalent), SaaS administration, and public cloud environments.
* Practical experience putting enterprise AI tools in employees’ hands at scale, beyond pilots.
* Vendor management and procurement, plus IT technical program management with globally distributed teams, and the working habits that make distributed leadership effective across time zones.
* Executive presence and influence in a matrix organization, with the ability to develop senior leaders and build a culture of integrity, service excellence, accountability, and best practice sharing across sites.

jobs.description:
GAQ327R240

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale.

Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.

**The impact you will have:**

* **Own the Global  AR Month-End Close:** Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.
* **Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling:** Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance
* **Lead AI & Automation Adoption:** Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.
* **Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity:** Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.
* **Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls:** Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.
* **Cross-Functional Process Alignment:** Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.
* **Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation:** Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

**What we look for:**

* **Experience:** 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.
* **Credentials:** CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.
* **Technical Accounting:** Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
## Role Description

The Dropbox Business Development team builds and grows strategic partnerships that expand Dropbox's reach, deepen product adoption, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. As a Business Development Manager, you will own a portfolio spanning AI, platform/developer, hardware, AI, and SaaS ecosystems. You will manage the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and commercial strategy through launch, ongoing growth, and partner success.

You will play a key role in shaping Dropbox's partnership strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business cases, and translating partner needs into integrated customer experiences. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute partnerships across device distribution and AI agent ecosystems. This role offers significant exposure to senior leaders and external executives while owning partnerships with meaningful strategic and commercial impact.

AI and automation are increasingly embedded in our workflows, accelerating research, partner preparation, and administrative work. Success in this role comes from using these capabilities to increase efficiency while focusing your time on strategic decision-making, commercial negotiations, and relationship management.

## Responsibilities

* Own and grow strategic distribution and ecosystem partnerships to drive customer acquisition, product adoption, and revenue growth.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop commercial opportunities with existing and prospective partners.
* Build business cases and financial models that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions.
* Lead or support commercial negotiations while balancing strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes.
* Build trusted executive relationships through regular business reviews, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Analyze partner performance and leverage data, experimentation, and AI-enabled tools to optimize commercial outcomes.
* Partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute complex partnership initiatives.

## Requirements

* 5+ years of experience in business development, distribution partnerships, product management, or related commercial roles within SaaS, cloud services, or technology.
* Demonstrated success building and growing strategic business partnerships that drive measurable business results.
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with experience evaluating partnership investments and ROI.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments.
* Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve research, analysis, communication, or workflow efficiency.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

## Preferred Qualifications

* MBA, consulting, or corporate strategy experience.
* Strong understanding of consumer technology ecosystems.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives across product and commercial organizations.
* Demonstrated success using AI-enabled workflows to improve commercial execution.

## Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

* **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others.
* **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
* **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
* **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this [blog post](https://www.dropbox.jobs/en/our-blog/employee-stories/the-era-of-durable-skills-what-the-data-tells-us-about-thriving-in-change/) from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2

$162,200—$219,400 USD

US Zone 3

$144,200—$195,000 USD

jobs.title: Director of Media Strategy & Activation (Paid Media)
Enterprise Context Architect
jobs.description:
## Role Description

Dropbox is building the knowledge layer that connects content, context, and action. As AI moves from assistants to systems that act, the structure and stewardship of enterprise knowledge becomes the difference between AI that helps and AI that fails.

This role defines the architecture and technical requirements for the context layer our AI depends on: what it can know, what it can trust, and what it is allowed to act on. You will shape the standards and approaches that make enterprise knowledge reliable, current, and permissions-aware, working across the enterprise on content and context architecture, retrieval and grounding, evaluation, semantic structure, permissions requirements, and prototyping, while domain experts remain accountable for the accuracy and stewardship of their content.

This is the first role of its kind at Dropbox. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Security, and your decisions will show up directly in how AI performs across the company.

## Responsibilities

* Define the source-of-truth strategy for enterprise knowledge: which systems are authoritative, what is indexed centrally versus fetched live, what is eligible for AI use, and what is archived or excluded, informed by an assessment of the authoritative sources behind our highest-value workflows.
* Define the enterprise standards that make content AI-ready across structure, metadata, provenance, and access, including where semantic models or knowledge graphs are warranted and where they are not, and translate them into authoring patterns adopted across domains.
* Design the control model for AI actions, including eligibility rules, preconditions, approval boundaries, escalation paths, and rollback requirements, so systems that act on enterprise knowledge stay traceable and safe as AI capabilities evolve.
* Lead platform and connector strategy across the content stack. Drive decisions on what is refactored, migrated, indexed in place, or consolidated, and partner with IT and Engineering on connector architecture and how AI systems are granted access to tools and sources.
* Build the federated operating model for enterprise content: stewardship across functions, domains accountable for their own accuracy within shared standards, and lifecycle policies covering review cadence, expiration, material-change triggers, and retirement, tied to business criticality.
* Define content quality in an AI context. Stand up retrieval and grounding evaluations for priority use cases, extend measurement to workflow traces and policy conformance as systems begin to act, and route findings back into the content lifecycle.
* Co-own the criteria for AI content eligibility, sensitivity classification, and permissions modeling with Legal, Privacy, and Security, including access boundaries for the tools AI systems can reach.

## Requirements

* 7+ years designing how information is structured, governed, owned, and maintained at enterprise scale, including at least 2 years supporting AI-enabled knowledge or retrieval systems.
* Direct experience preparing content for AI consumption, with working fluency in RAG, grounding, semantic chunking, embeddings, vector search, and citations.
* Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic models for machine-readable content.
* Practical experience evaluating retrieval and grounding quality, testing hypotheses, and building lightweight prototypes independently or with Engineering.
* Track record building federated operating models across functions outside direct reporting lines, including metadata standards or authoring frameworks adopted at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Security, and business functions.
* Sound judgment in balancing centralized standards with domain-specific expertise and ownership.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Atlassian, Microsoft 365 or Copilot Search, Slack, or Notion.
* Familiarity with structured authoring (such as DITA), controlled vocabularies, or knowledge operations methodologies such as KCS.
* Experience with AI evaluation tooling and frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, groundedness, and answer relevance.
* Background working in regulated, policy-heavy, or high-risk content domains.
* Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI guidance, or comparable risk frameworks.

## Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

* **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others.
* **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
* **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
* **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this [blog post](https://www.dropbox.jobs/en/our-blog/employee-stories/the-era-of-durable-skills-what-the-data-tells-us-about-thriving-in-change/) from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.title: Head of Field and Partner Marketing
jobs.description:
## Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a **Head of Field & Partner Marketing** to lead our global field and partner marketing organization and drive pipeline growth across our **Sales-Led Growth****(SLG)** business and strategic partner ecosystem. 

This executive Go-To-Market (GTM) leader will own the regional marketing strategy, account-based execution, mid-to-bottom funnel demand engines, and partner marketing required to scale business-to-business revenue globally.  While our PLG team focuses on the frictionless, self-serve transactional customer lifecycle, this leader owns the end-to-end marketing journey for sales-engaged and partner-led motions. 

This role requires an exceptional strategic operator who can orchestrate targeted account-based marketing (ABM) and regional demand generation alongside localized partner programs—including managing co-marketing initiatives with strategic AI technology ecosystems (ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) and supporting our distribution networks. Partnering closely with regional Sales and Channel leaders, this executive will oversee integrated campaigns, joint partner value propositions, content strategies, and comprehensive PLG to SLG customer lifecycle initiatives.

## Responsibilities

* **SLG & Partner Pipeline Accountability:** Own the strategic vision and performance metrics (creation, coverage, and acceleration) for both direct field pipeline and indirect partner-led business globally.
* **Integrated Demand Generation:** Lead the Integrated Marketing team to design and deploy highly optimized mid- and bottom-funnel acquisition campaigns that move prospects effectively through the sales pipeline.
* **Content & Customer Campaigns:** Oversee the upstream Campaigns team to deliver compelling content frameworks and high-impact customer marketing initiatives that drive post-sale engagement, adoption, brand advocacy, and net revenue retention (NRR).
* **Partner Alliance & Co-Marketing:** Develop and execute high-impact joint marketing programs with strategic AI and productivity ecosystem partners (including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini). Build compelling value propositions that position Dropbox as the core content layer for modern workflows.
* **Distribution & Channel Support:** Oversee marketing strategies to and through Dropbox’s distribution networks and cloud marketplaces to support our incremental channel revenue stream.
* **Account-Based Marketing****(ABM)** **Strategy:** Build, scale, and institutionalize Dropbox’s ABM framework. Define account selection, tiering, multi-channel orchestration, and tailored campaigns for high-value corporate and mid-market accounts.
* **PLG-to-SLG Monetization:** Partner closely with the PLG Digital Marketing and Product teams to identify accounts with high existing self-serve usage, triggering targeted field and partner campaigns to convert them into larger team or corporate agreements.
* **Sales & Partner Architecture Interlock:** Establish trusted partnerships with regional Sales VPs and the Alliance organization to align on territory strategies, partner incentives, target account lists, and quarterly outbound cadences.
* **Experiential & Executive Engagement:** Oversee the global portfolio of regional field events, proprietary customer advisory boards (CABs), executive roundtable programs, and major industry tech activations.

jobs.description:
## Role Description

As the Principal, Market & Competitive Intelligence Manager you will lead Dropbox’s enterprise competitive intelligence program across Dropbox Core, DocSend, Sign and Sign API, and Dropbox Protect.

Sitting within the Chief Business Officer’s organization, you will work close to the company’s most important strategic and go-to-market decisions. You will build the operating system that turns competitor activity, market developments, customer feedback, win/loss findings, and field signals into clear recommendations and action.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role for a senior individual contributor. You will strengthen Dropbox’s competitive positioning, improve how our teams navigate competitive sales cycles, inform product and go-to-market choices, and deepen executive understanding of a rapidly changing market. Your work will span both sales-led and product-led motions and help Dropbox tell a sharper, more differentiated story.

You will partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Research, Revenue Operations, Analyst Relations, and Communications. Success requires equal strength in strategic judgment and execution: identifying what matters, developing a defensible point of view, and delivering useful recommendations and tools at the speed of the business.

## Responsibilities

* Lead Dropbox’s enterprise competitive intelligence program across Dropbox Core, DocSend, Sign and Sign API, and Dropbox Protect.
* Establish a company-wide operating model for collecting, prioritizing, analyzing, distributing, and measuring competitive intelligence.
* Translate competitor launches, pricing and product changes, AI developments, customer feedback, and market shifts into actionable recommendations for Sales, GTM Strategy, Product Marketing, Product, and executive leadership.
* Produce decision-ready intelligence—including executive briefings, competitive points of view, rapid-response analysis, battlecards, alerts, and market coverage—tailored to executive, strategic, product, and field audiences.
* Own and modernize Dropbox’s win/loss program in partnership with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing, creating a recurring feedback loop into positioning, enablement, product strategy, and go-to-market decisions.
* Equip customer-facing teams to compete more effectively while partnering with product-aligned PMMs to strengthen differentiation, objection handling, field confidence, and product-specific competitive activation.
* Use AI, automation, and modern research platforms to scale the program, establish clear success measures, and maintain a trusted network of competitive contributors across Dropbox.

## Requirements

* 10+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, market strategy, corporate strategy, or a related B2B SaaS discipline.
* Demonstrated ownership of an end-to-end competitive intelligence program, including executive intelligence, win/loss analysis, field enablement, and strategic recommendations.
* A record of translating complex qualitative and quantitative signals into clear points of view that influenced product, go-to-market, or revenue decisions.
* Deep experience partnering with Sales, GTM Strategy, Product Marketing, and Product teams in competitive markets and customer situations.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate concise, evidence-based recommendations to senior leaders.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with a record of creating alignment and driving action in complex organizations without formal authority.
* Exceptional analytical, written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to balance long-range strategic work and fast-turn execution.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in AI-powered software, content management, collaboration, e-signature, document workflows, or security markets.
* Experience building or modernizing competitive intelligence across a multi-product portfolio or decentralized organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Crayon, Clozd, and AlphaSense, including using AI and automation to scale research, synthesis, and delivery.
* Experience partnering with Revenue Operations or Sales Operations to measure program adoption, decision influence, and business impact.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Design Engineer on the Design Acceleration team, you’ll be an individual contributor focused on evolving the systems and processes which power Roblox’s design organization through scalable systems, AI integrations, and custom tooling. Our team is responsible for building the orchestration layers and internal tools that empower designers and engineers to work faster and more cohesively. You will help build internal tools, like Figma plugins and design utilities, that empower designers and engineers to work faster and more cohesively.

You have experience at the intersection of systems engineering and design tooling. You understand design systems, but your superpower is building the backend services, APIs, and data models that allow those systems to scale. Your work will help ensure our design tools, AI agents, and prototypes not only inspire—but deploy seamlessly into production environments.

**You will:**

* Architect and build scalable backend services and APIs that connect our design tools to AI models and production environments (Roblox Studio).
* Develop agentic workflows and orchestration layers (such as Model Context Protocol servers) to enable natural language generation of UI components, layouts, and prototypes.
* Build automated CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure to abstract away complex DevOps workflows, creating "zero-config" development environments for non-technical designers.
* Design and maintain the data architecture that connects our design system to our AI data sources, ensuring design tokens and components are programmatically accessible and synced across multiple platforms.
* Create internal tools, develop plugins for tools like Figma and Cursor, and build web apps focused on design linting, code generation, and automated compliance at scale.
* Serve as the deeply technical bridge between core engineering, AI research, and product design, ensuring our design acceleration tools are secure, performant, and structurally sound.
* You will report to the Manager of Design Acceleration.

**You have:**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on full-stack or backend development, systems architecture, and API design.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable internal services, not just frontend interfaces.
* Familiarity with LLM orchestration, agentic workflows, and AI protocols (e.g., MCP).
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, feature-flag management, version control (GitHub Enterprise), and automated deployment pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Figma plugin architecture and how to programmatically parse and manipulate design data at scale.
* (Nice to have) Experience with Roblox development, Lua/React-Lua, or game-engine UI architecture.
* (Nice to have) Experience with ASTs (Abstract Syntax Trees), compiler logic, or automated code generation.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Automotive Vertical
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Business is changing the way companies, brands, and organizations alike leverage the Lyft platform to redefine the way they operate. We are solving big problems and meeting the needs of our clients and their people, from employees to customers and students to patients, in a whole new way. We are committed to always delivering best in class customer service. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we are looking for a customer-focused team member passionate about solving problems and delighting our customers.

As an Account Manager, Automotive on the Lyft Business team, you’ll help Automotive Dealerships get more out of Lyft and its solutions after the sale. You’ll join a talented team focused on one thing: using technology and Lyft’s network of drivers to improve transportation for a company’s customers and employees. We’re looking for smart, ambitious individuals with account management experience who want to transform the way people move around and succeed in a fast moving environment.

## **Responsibilities:**

* Own a book of existing dealership accounts, with responsibility for retention, adoption, and revenue growth
* Build and manage an expansion pipeline within your accounts by developing trusted client relationships from first renewal conversation to signed expansion
* Accurately forecast, track, and manage revenue, renewals, and churn risk with multiple systems and tools (Salesforce, Claude, Gemini, Outreach, Google Suite, Mode, and Tableau)
* Achieve quarterly retention and net revenue growth targets
* Running quarterly business reviews, monitoring account usage and health data, and re-engaging dormant users and accounts
* Be the primary point of contact and build relationships with multiple decision makers across the dealership and dealer group
* Establish collaborative relationships with Lyft Business customers and demonstrate Lyft value to client-focused initiatives
* Facilitate training, account review, customer engagement, and customer success criteria
* Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Support, and Product, to resolve client issues and drive the effectiveness of account initiatives
* Represent Lyft at marketing and trade show events
* Travel up to 20% of the time for meetings and visits to client locations
* Reports directly to the Manager of Automotive Sales

## **Experience:**

* 2+ years of B2B account management, customer success, or renewals experience carrying a retention or growth number (SaaS API integration, ad-tech, or transportation a plus)
* Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM, AI tooling, and a knack for learning new sales tech
* A passion for mobility, the auto industry, or simply making transportation and logistics easy
* Experience owning the post-sale lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, objection-handling, and upsell
* Comfort using usage and performance data to identify risk and surface growth opportunities
* Demonstrated success in exceeding retention or growth targets
* Excellent communication skills - A big part of the role is talking to clients on the phone and in-person
* Possess a competitive spirit and are excited to prove not to others, but to yourself, what you are capable of
* High energy, you like to get things done and make things happen
* Self starter, loves to win, and grow professionally
* Ambitious and not afraid of putting yourself out there

## **Benefits:**

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

*Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.*

*Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid*

*The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $60,800-$76,000 not inclusive of potential equity offering, variable or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.*

jobs.title: AI Business Solutions Architect, People Technology
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The divide between business needs and technical delivery is one of the most persistent challenges in enterprise technology, where People teams struggle to articulate requirements and engineering teams lack the business context to build truly impactful solutions. As a Senior Business Solution Architect for People at Lyft, you'll eliminate this gap by serving as the critical connection point between our People teams and our Corporate Engineering and IT (CEIT) organization. This customer obsessed role uniquely combines deep functional business expertise with strong technical acumen, with an AI native approach, enabling you to translate complex business needs into systemized, scalable solutions while driving AI-enabled transformation across the People function.

We're seeking a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of business and technology, possesses exceptional communication skills across both technical and non-technical audiences, and is dedicated to architecting the future AI Native state of how the People function operates. You'll be the trusted advisor to both business leaders and engineering teams, ensuring our People organization has systems and processes that scale with our business while our engineering teams build solutions that truly move the needle. With AI fundamentally reshaping how the People function gets work done, your expertise will be critical in helping us responsibly harness these technologies to drive operational excellence. In this role, you'll reimagine People workflows through an AI-first lens, design business processes that balance operational excellence with technical feasibility, and champion automation that elevates teams from tactical execution to strategic impact.

If you are a candidate who has the vision of what could be, who has the ability to cultivate relationships, and has a belief in driving impact, then you may be the ideal person for this position. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

## **Responsibilities:**

* **Architect People Solutions and Bridge Business-Technology Collaboration**
  + Serve as the primary liaison between People stakeholders and engineering teams, translating both global and localized business needs into clear technical requirements taking an AI-Native approach and validating that delivered solutions meet business objectives.
  + Maintain deep expertise in both People domain knowledge (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Onboarding, Learning & Development, Employee Experience) and the technical systems that support it (Workday, Greenhouse, CultureAmp, and various boundary applications), enabling effective communication across both audiences.
  + Define the strategic roadmap for AI-First People systems, platforms, and data architecture in alignment with business strategy and technology capabilities.
  + Design and document business processes that streamline workflows, eliminate redundancies, and improve operational efficiency while ensuring technical feasibility.
  + Develop comprehensive business requirements documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* **Drive AI-Enabled Transformation Across People**
  + Partner with People leaders to reimagine processes through an AI-first lens, prototyping solutions that demonstrate art-of-the-possible and building conviction for change.
  + Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across People workflows, from candidate screening and onboarding to personalized learning and predictive retention analysis, pushing teams up the value chain by eliminating mundane, repetitive work.
  + Establish frameworks for responsible AI adoption within People, ensuring solutions align with compliance, data privacy, security guidelines, and ethical considerations.
  + Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and tools, continuously researching how new models and platforms can be applied to People use cases.
* **Enable Strategic Decision-Making and Platform Optimization**
  + Develop business cases that quantify ROI for technology investments, translating technical capabilities into tangible business value metrics.
  + Lead People systems architecture discussions, providing guidance on integrations, data flows, technical dependencies, and impact of proposed changes.
  + Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure People solutions adhere to data privacy, audit standards, and regulatory obligations related to employee data.
  + Support M&A integration efforts by assessing acquired companies' People systems and architecting integration roadmaps that minimize business disruption.

## **Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience in business solution architecture, business process design, People/HR systems implementation, or related roles, with deep expertise in People operations and systems.
* Experience with AI/automation in business contexts, including familiarity with LLMs, intelligent automation tools, or AI-powered workflow solutions.
* Proven track record translating complex business requirements into technical solutions, working at the intersection of People teams and engineering.
* Strong technical foundation including understanding of system architecture, APIs, data modeling, integration patterns, and modern SaaS platforms.
* Demonstrated success leading business process transformation initiatives in People/HR that delivered measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, or user experience.
* Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, from explaining technical concepts to CHRO and People executives to providing detailed specifications to engineers.
* **Preferred Qualifications**
  + Hands-on experience with core People enterprise systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Dayforce, or similar platforms.
  + Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Workato, automation platforms like UiPath or Power Automate)
  + Experience with change management and driving adoption of new systems or processes across large People organizations.
  + Background in product management, solution architecture, or technical program management.
  + Experience in high-growth tech companies or organizations undergoing significant digital transformation.
  + M&A integration experience, particularly People systems consolidation and harmonization.

jobs.title: Analyste Financier
jobs.description:
Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.

Lyft recherche un analyste financier pour rejoindre son équipe FP&A (Planification et Analyse Financières) au sein de Lyft Urban Solutions (vélos en libre-service et micromobilité). Ce poste est axé sur la planification financière, la modélisation des réponses aux appels d'offres et l'analyse stratégique. Le candidat idéal possédera une solide expertise en modélisation financière, un grand souci du détail, un esprit d'initiative et une capacité à évoluer efficacement dans un contexte d'incertitude. Doté d'une mentalité d'amélioration continue, il contribuera à la prise de décisions stratégiques chez Lyft. Outre l'analyse en appui à la prise de décision stratégique, ce poste comprendra également la gestion et le reporting des clôtures financières.

## **Responsabilités:**

* Responsabilité des activités principales de planification et d'analyse financières (FP&A) : budgétisation, prévisions, analyse des écarts et reporting financier mensuel pour la direction.
* Soutien aux processus de clôture mensuelle : rapprochement des réalisations avec le budget, identification et explication des écarts, validation des provisions, coordination avec la comptabilité.
* Synthèse des données financières issues de sources multiples (Oracle, systèmes de gestion de flotte, données de compte de résultat) en modèles clairs et bien documentés.
* Maintien et amélioration des modèles de prévision financière et des processus de reporting.
* Identification et mise en œuvre d'améliorations de processus pour réduire les interventions manuelles, accroître l'automatisation et améliorer la précision et la transparence des données.
* Collaboration avec les équipes Opérations et Commerciales sur les exigences des appels d'offres, les hypothèses de coûts et la modélisation financière des scénarios d'appel d'offres.
* Élaboration de modèles financiers complets pour les appels d'offres : projections sur 10 ans couvrant la taille de la flotte, le déploiement des capitaux, les coûts unitaires et la rentabilité.
* Réalisation d'analyses de scénarios et de tests de sensibilité sur les modèles d'appel d'offres afin de tester la robustesse des hypothèses et d'éclairer la prise de décision.
* Création et présentation d'analyses financières, de supports de présentation et de synthèses pour la direction, communiquant les performances, les enseignements et les recommandations.

## **Expérience:**

* Solide sens des affaires et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Opérations, Commerciales et Finances.
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement d'équipe dynamique, à communiquer efficacement et à présenter les informations de manière claire et concise, en adaptant son point de vue aux besoins de chaque interlocuteur.
* Maîtrise d'Excel (Google Sheets) en modélisation financière et en résolution de problèmes ; capacité à créer des modèles complexes, des tableaux croisés dynamiques, à utiliser la fonction RECHERCHEV et à réaliser des analyses de scénarios.
* Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et capacité à travailler en collaboration avec différentes fonctions et à présenter des informations aux décideurs.
* Souci du détail, sens de l'organisation et volonté de comprendre les enjeux commerciaux sous-jacents et d'en identifier les causes profondes.
* Maîtrise des outils de présentation (Google Slides/PowerPoint) et de modélisation financière ; la connaissance d'Anaplan est un atout.
* Capacité démontrée à travailler de manière autonome et à respecter les délais dans un environnement dynamique.
* Connaissance des processus de clôture mensuelle, de l'analyse des écarts et des principes comptables généralement admis (PCGR).
* La ​​connaissance d'Oracle ou d'un système ERP similaire est un plus.
* Une expérience dans le secteur de la mobilité partagée, les entreprises à forte intensité capitalistique ou les processus d'appel d'offres est un atout.
* Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français ; la maîtrise de l'espagnol est un plus.

## **Avantages:**

* Excellente couverture d’assurance santé, dentaire, vision, ainsi que l’assurance vie et prestation d’invalidité
* Programme de soutien en santé mentale
* Soutien à la fertilité et à la planification familiale
* Avantage pour les soins d'animaux de compagnie
* Compte de dépenses de santé (HSA)

jobs.title: Applied Scientist Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Lyft Rider Science team is seeking an Applied Scientist intern to develop next-generation user simulation methods using state of the art AI methods. The goal of this project is to develop and validate LLM-based Rider Agents that can serve as behavioral proxies for real riders, and study when agent simulations can provide reliable signal about rider responses to product interventions before online experimentation.

You will build agent-based simulation systems grounded in real rider context and behavioral data, evaluate their fidelity against observed rider behavior and historical experiments, and study where these simulations can accelerate product iteration and experimentation.

This role combines LLM engineering, agent-based modeling, machine learning, and causal inference with direct applications to real-world rider products. The expected outcome is to build a working Rider Agent simulation prototype, establish an evaluation framework for measuring simulation fidelity and validate the framework using historical rider experiments.

## **Responsibilities:**

* Develop LLM-based Rider Agents that represent heterogeneous rider contexts, preferences, histories, and behaviors
* Build agent-based simulation environments for evaluating rider interactions with different product experiences and interventions
* Build evaluation pipelines to assess realism, robustness, and mechanism plausibility of simulated behavior against human data or established theory
* Analyze emergent behaviors and interaction dynamics in simulated populations under different user segment and marketplace conditions
* Conduct experiments and ablation studies on agent behavior, interaction dynamics, and simulation validity
* Apply the simulation framework to real Rider product problems and assess its usefulness for hypothesis generation, product iteration, and pre-experiment evaluation
* Communicate technical findings and recommendations to science, engineering, and product partners

## **Experience:**

* Currently pursuing a **PhD degree** in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field, with a graduation date between **December 2027 and Summer 2028 (required)**
* Proficiency with Python and working in a production coding environment
* Hands-on experience with large language models or agent-based systems
* Strong foundation in machine learning and empirical model evaluation
* Ability to independently develop prototypes and work through open-ended technical problems
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem
* Familiarity with A/B testing, causal inference, or experimental design

  + Experience building production level ML inference, simulation, or evaluation pipelines
  + Prior research experience with LLM agents, generative user simulation, or agent-based modeling
  + Background in computational social science or behavioral modeling
  + Experience evaluating AI systems against human behavioral data, qualitative studies, or controlled experiments

jobs.title: Associate Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive is a subsidiary of Lyft that works together with Lyft teams to realize our shared mission.

Flexdrive builds the operational backbone for the future of mobility. As a fleet management leader and Lyft subsidiary, the company extends its expertise into autonomous vehicle infrastructure — managing the physical operations that keep fleets safe, available, and performing at scale. The Nashville depot is the first proof point in a multi-market expansion.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. This role exists because one Operations Manager cannot provide the people leadership, floor coverage, and operational bandwidth a 24/7 depot of this scale requires.

The Associate Operations Manager carries ownership across two critical business workstreams: workforce scheduling support and process standards compliance. Fleet Operations Leads report to the Operations Manager — but during mid shifts, the Associate Operations Manager is the operational authority on the floor, directing their work, setting the quality standard, and serving as their most experienced resource and mentor.

This is a management role with a floor orientation. The Associate Operations Manager is present, coaching, directing, and executing alongside the team — while simultaneously carrying business responsibilities that directly impact depot readiness and partner compliance. This role is the bridge between the Fleet Operations Lead layer and the Operations Manager.

## **Responsibilities:**

* **Scheduling & Workforce Planning Support**
  + Owns the depot schedule — building, maintaining, and adjusting shift coverage across all teams to ensure the depot is consistently staffed and operationally ready.
  + Monitors attendance, manages real-time coverage gaps, and proactively addresses workforce trends before they become operational problems.
  + Partners with the Operations Manager on workforce planning, surfacing scheduling risks and recommendations with enough lead time to act.
* **Training Program Execution & Certification Compliance**
  + Owns the planning and coordination of training program execution across all shift teams — ensuring Fleet Operations Associates and Fleet Operations Leads are scheduled, prepared, and on track to complete required partner certifications, safety refreshers, and qualification renewals.
  + Maintains certification and qualification records for the team, flagging upcoming renewals and escalating compliance risks to the Operations Manager before they become audit findings.
  + Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.
* **Floor Execution & Quality Standards**
  + Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.
  + Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts — directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets.
  + Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards — inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team.
  + Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.
* **Fleet Operations Lead Mentorship & Operational Direction**
  + Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift — task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations.
  + Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.

## **Experience:**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in operational leadership, with a strong understanding of autonomous vehicle (AV) or complex fleet operational environments.
* Proven track record of launching and scaling new operational sites or programs, including accountability for facilities,  team performance, and operational outcomes.
* Demonstrated expertise in safety management and regulatory compliance within transportation, automotive, or similar regulated industries.
* Experience executing incident response and coordinating multi-vendor support in complex operational environments.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed, to effectively support and lead a 24/7 AV depot operation.
* Exceptional leadership in training execution and team development, with the ability to lead high-performing teams in safety-critical operations at scale.
* Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable decisions and surface clear recommendations to leadership.
* Demonstrated leadership ability in fast-paced, high-accountability environments, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to drive cross-functional alignment and lead on-site operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.

## **Benefits:**

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

**Note****: For this role, candidates must reside in states registered for Flexdrive Services LLC.**

This role is on-site at a Lyft Flexdrive hub or office location full time. **#Onsite**
